description: I am a military veteran and a gun owner, and I support the Second Amendment. I also believe firearm safety is a serious responsibility— not a slogan, not a culture-war prop, but something that has to be lived. I do not see a contradiction between those positions. I see the whole point.Long before I served in uniform, I learned firearm safety through Scouting.
